2608.07364.title: Curriculum as Code: An AI-Assisted Architecture for Instructional Design in STEM Education
2608.07364.paper_summary: Contribution: This paper presents a six-phase AI-assisted instructional design architecture based on the Curriculum as Code paradigm, integrating Generative AI with LaTeX and Python to automate the creation of reproducible, visually consistent, and technically precise materials for STEM education. Background: Creating customized instructional materials for active learning imposes a heavy workload on faculty. Standard presentation tools lack robust support for technical content, while current AI applications often hallucinate and fail to formalize the instructional authoring process, limiting their utility for rigorous academic design. Intended Outcomes: The framework aims to reduce preparation time while ensuring mathematical accuracy, adherence to institutional visual identity, and preservation of the instructor's tacit pedagogical knowledge through explicit rules. Application Design: The solution comprises a six-phase pipeline that replaces ad-hoc prompt engineering with a systematic workflow, utilizing text-based interfaces and code-driven generation (LaTeX/Beamer for slides, Python for figures), governed by pedagogical constraints, contextual calibrations, and automated review cycles. Findings: Validated over one year across 8 modules and 28 project contexts in a Project-Based Learning environment, the architecture significantly reduced instructor workload. Generated assets underwent independent peer review and were deployed by six different faculty members, confirming scalability beyond a single author. Based on over 600 voluntary student evaluations, materials achieved high quality ratings from 8.5 to 9.9/10. Results indicate high reproducibility, minimized hallucinations, and sustained pedagogical and visual fidelity, suggesting viability for broad STEM educational applications.
2608.07364.paper_summary_zh: 貢獻：本文提出了一種基於課程作為代碼範式的六階段AI輔助教學設計架構，將生成式AI與LaTeX和Python整合，以自動化創建可重複、視覺一致且技術精確的STEM教育材料。<lb/>背景：為主動學習創建定制的教學材料對教職員造成了沉重的工作負擔。標準的演示工具缺乏對技術內容的強大支持，而當前的AI應用經常出現幻覺，無法正式化教學創作過程，限制了其在嚴謹學術設計中的實用性。<lb/>預期成果：該框架旨在減少準備時間，同時確保數學準確性、遵循機構的視覺識別以及通過明確規則保留教師的隱性教學知識。<lb/>應用設計：該解決方案包括一個六階段的流程，將臨時提示工程替換為系統化的工作流程，利用基於文本的界面和代碼驅動的生成（使用LaTeX/Beamer製作幻燈片，使用Python製作圖形），受教學約束、上下文校準和自動審查循環的約束。<lb/>研究結果：在一年的時間內，該架構在8個模組和28個項目背景中進行驗證，顯著減少了教師的工作負擔。生成的資產經過獨立的同行評審，並由六位不同的教職員部署，證實了其超越單一作者的可擴展性。<lb/>根據600多份自願的學生評價，材料的質量評分達到8.5到9.9/10的高評價。結果顯示出高重現性、最小化幻覺以及持續的教學和視覺忠實度，表明其在廣泛的STEM教育應用中的可行性。
